label: Opening Hook
text: In December 1900, three lighthouse keepers vanished from a remote Scottish island, and no trace of them was ever found.
title: File:Admiralty Chart No 3331 Flannan Isles, Published 1903.jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Eilean Mor in the Flannan Isles, Outer Hebrides; absence discovered on 26 December 1900 Keepers James Ducat, Thomas Marshall and Donald MacArthur were missing The official inquiry concluded they were probably swept away by a huge wave during a storm Details like an overturned chair, an uneaten meal or eerie log entries come largely from a 1912 poem and later retellings The lighthouse was automated in 1971
title: File:Flannan isles.jpg
